_note: Everything a returning player sees change, driven by data and the UTC week index (Progression.week / Remix.week, weeks start Monday 00:00 UTC). Adding an entry to any list is a data-only content update. Numbers are hypotheses. Stage 3 (WP-21) unless noted.
principles: Nothing here is exclusive to a date: every gauntlet, reward and spotlight returns on a fixed cycle, so a missed week costs nothing permanent
Targets are skill thresholds, never volume ('do X once well', not 'do X 200 times')
No streaks, no login rewards, no timers that punish absence

spotlight.effect: that species has one extra pod in its arena (spare habitat) and its signature catches count double toward signature stars for the week

weekly.note: lcm(6,5,3,12): the same full combination returns after 60 weeks; any single element returns within 6

remixes.name: Golden Rush
remixes.rule: two extra Golden Runaways in the finale

remixes.name: Big Herd
remixes.rule: every arena's spare habitat holds a pod and the Stampede brings 4 more

remixes.name: Stampede Season
remixes.rule: a second Stampede at 95 s on the other route

remixes.name: Starfall Everywhere
remixes.rule: Starfall replaces the signature event in every arena (impact points: that arena's bloom buds / geysers)

remixes.name: Fizz Festival
remixes.rule: Static Puff pops are worth double; Puffs appear only at Heat 1+

gauntlets.name: Feet Only
gauntlets.tests: herding and positioning without SNAP or boops

gauntlets.name: Three Stampedes
gauntlets.rule: no pods; a Stampede at 20, 55 and 90 s

gauntlets.name: Big Game
gauntlets.rule: only Uncommon and Rare species spawn; respawn 4 s
gauntlets.tests: every species counter back to back

gauntlets.name: Full Parade
gauntlets.rule: banking is only possible with a full parade; a zap ends the run

gauntletFormat.run: one 110 s solo run on the Trial paddock of the week's arena, seeded by the week index: identical for everyone that week (reuses the Daily Stampede machinery, WP-15)
gauntletFormat.board: weekly best-score board per gauntlet (existing weekly leaderboard), reset each week

seals.relativeTo: that gauntlet's par score, set from the round model then from real runs
seals.kept: the best seal per gauntlet is permanent and shown in the Album

gauntletFormat.rewards: each gauntlet owns one ribbon texture set, unlocked at its Silver seal, recoloured at Gold, animated at Radiant. Available whenever that gauntlet is the week's (every 5 weeks), forever

feats._note: Permanent, authored mastery cards shown in the Album: one per species, plus arena and technique feats. Each is a single well-played moment. Conditions use a small vocabulary the server evaluates on each Loop result or at round end.

vocabulary.species: species id that must be in the loop / counted
vocabulary.techs: all listed techniques on that loop
vocabulary.stateAtCatch: Herd state the creature was in at the view clock
vocabulary.chain: minimum multiplier when the loop lands
vocabulary.event: loop made on creatures from this event
vocabulary.noDash: no dash used in the round
vocabulary.wall: pinch wall feature id or type
